title: Mochizuki Honami — A Bell Of Gratitude And Blessing〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: A Bell Of Gratitude And Blessing（4★）

rows.Line: Shopping Mall - Bookstore

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Let's see... Oh, here it is.
I need this book, and the other one must be over there...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad I was able to find both. That just leaves...
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That was delicious.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Today's lunch was great♪
I've got a full tummy and it's super nice out, which makes it the perfect time to take a nap.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, if you're full already, I guess I should hold off on these...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: These?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I bought a cookbook yesterday and gave one of the sweets recipes a try.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, you made yummy treats?! Gimme! I want some!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I thought you were full, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No way! I always have room for dessert♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Pretty sure you just want to eat them that badly.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Ichika, Shiho, would you like some as well?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, please.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, these are chocolate cakes and these are banana. I made them into sticks, so they should be easy to pick up and eat.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow!
Alright, let's...♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Shiho
rows.Line: Dig in!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hm...! Mmmmm!
These are sooo good!!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, and they have a nice aftertaste. I could snack on these all day...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
The banana cakes are also good.
My mouth's being filled with the sweet aroma of bananas...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Nom... Mmmm!
You're right! The sweet flavor and aroma is filling my mouth with so much joy!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks for making these, Honami.
They're really good.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're welcome. I'm glad you all like them so much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm actually thinking about learning to make more of these types of soothing snacks.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But you already know how to make all kinds of stuff. What's gotten into you? Did something happen recently?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There's something I felt spending time with you and the others today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
How do I put it...?
Having someone next to me with my best interests in mind is such a nice thing.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm convinced now that I can keep composing songs because you're there to support me, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, thank you for everything you do.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll have to keep that a secret.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...? Well, I guess I shouldn't complain if it means getting to have these delicious snacks.
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I don't think anyone's been using this classroom much lately.
Still, are you sure you want to go through the trouble of cleaning it...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. So, I bought this book by a famous housekeeper yesterday, but I couldn't quite find enough to do at my own house.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which is why I really appreciate you helping me find a place where I can put their ideas into practice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. In that case...

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line: Miku-P, where are you?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, sorry. I need to go...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, have fun.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright, let's begin by gathering up what's here and cleaning the walls!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How are things going, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa! The walls, the windows and the floor are all spotless!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's incredible. This place used to be full of dust bunnies. I can't believe how clean it is now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. We can thank the homemade cleaner recipe I found in this book. Just by mixing a few household products together, you can get a much stronger solution.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was able to clean the walls so quickly that I decided to try it on the windows and the floor as well.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I didn't know it'd make everything sparkle like this! Oh, do you have any of that solution left? I wanna try!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, it's in this bottle.
Just lightly soak a rag in it and wipe down any dirty spots you see. Then, use a clean rag to dry it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll give it a try!
But everything here's clean, so I'm going to the corridor!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Says the person who always complains about having to clean things up.

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line: Whoa, this is so cool! And fun♪ It makes everything so shiny!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That reminds me of what Ms. Yoisaki said the other day...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: All you have to do is line up the cucumbers that you just cut into strips and...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Voila. You can julienne them fairly quickly without having to realign them each time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I remember seeing my mom do this. So there was a reason behind what she was doing.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. Cooking becomes more fun after you learn tricks like this one.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You seem more animated than usual lately, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I do? If so, I have Rin to thank.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There was something on my mind until just recently, but she helped encourage me...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line: Haha! Hey, check this out!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hm? That sounded like Rin...
But her voice felt really far away.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes... Where do you think she is now?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, she's shouting something again.
But she's too far away. I don't understand what she's saying.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I suspect every corridor's going to be glowing by the time she returns.
